{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue_clean'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Filter for completed orders and exclude internal test orders
filtered_df = df[(df['status'] == 'completed') & (df['revenue_clean'] != 999999.99)]

# Now compute and print the required numbers
num_completed = len(filtered_df)
print("Number of completed orders (after excluding test orders):")
print(num_completed)

total_revenue = filtered_df['revenue_clean'].sum()
print("Total revenue from completed orders (excluding test orders):")
print(total_revenue)

# Print the raw sum as a float for the value field
print("Raw total revenue (for value field):")
print(total_revenue)"}
